Just got into Outlier from Handshake and instantly failed my first onboarding… is this normal?
Hey all,

I just got accepted onto Outlier after doing some projects on Handshake and was pretty excited to start.

I went through the onboarding for the Aether project, spent about an hour trying to give detailed answers and take it seriously… and as soon as I finished, the system marked it as failed automatically.

No feedback, no explanation, just instantly failed.

Is this something that happens often with Outlier onboarding? Do they just filter people out pretty aggressively during the qualification stage?

Also curious how the project assignment flow works after something like this. Do you usually get moved to another project automatically, or do you just sit in the queue until something else pops up?

Trying to understand if this is just part of how the platform works or if I messed something up on my first go.

Would love to hear how it went for other people when they first started.
